changes.ice: Transmission with IOR 1.31; explicit air pockets and fissures; patchy roughness; rigid fragments.
changes.glass: Thin irregular panes, bevel geometry, IOR 1.52.
changes.crystal: Intergrown mineral prisms with absorptive interiors, rough matrix and added fill lighting.
changes.lava: Persistent particle IDs drive surface crust placement; cooling ages drive blackbody temperature; viscous FLIP geometry.
changes.lightning: Three-dimensional branching emission channels and restrained optical bloom.
changes.foam: Hollow water-film shells, heavy-tailed bubble radii; FLIP particle centers.
changes.healing: Broken fibers geometrically reconnect behind a moving luminous front; repaired structure remains.
changes.spirit: Disordered filaments transition to a coherent luminous structure. No liquid mesh.
changes.energy: Counter-propagating amber and blue filament fields with a sustained exchange region. No liquid mesh.
changes.metal: Brushed reflective strips with solid edges, anisotropic highlights, and bend deformation.
changes.plants: Irregular leaf placement, modeled curved blades, vein shading and translucent edges.
changes.sand: Fine ballistic grains with gravity, drag, and ground response.
changes.snow: Fine powder grains with reduced settling speed.

limits: Art-directed bending forces and material approximations; not a calibrated multi-physics model.
Lightning branching is procedural, not electrical breakdown simulation.
Lava cooling uses particle age, not a solved heat equation.
Healing, spiritbending, and energybending are stylized geometric VFX interpretations, not physical simulations.
Sand and snow use ballistic grains; interparticle collisions are not solved.
Lava surface fissures include procedural shading; they are not a thermal fracture solve.
